rationale: The agent verified identity using full name and zip, matched to a single user, then retrieved the correct pending order. It sought explicit confirmation before attempting to remove the fleece jacket, and when the tool disallowed removal without exchange, it presented compliant alternatives. Upon the user’s confirmation, it canceled the entire pending order with a captured reason and the tool confirmed cancellation and refund. Later, it provided the correct per-item grill prices from a delivered order. All actions were on the authenticated user’s account. One minor nit is the generic refund timing (5–7 business days) which wasn’t sourced from the tools, but this does not materially affect completion or policy adherence. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
